citations.title: British American Tobacco - Tadeu Marroco

sentences.text: Tadeu Marroco, a Brazilian national, has been Chief Executive of British American Tobacco p.l.c. since May 2023, having joined the Group in 1992 and the Management Board as Director, Business Development, in 2014.

sentences.text: He was Regional Director, Western Europe from 2016 and Regional Director, Europe and North Africa from January 2018, then became Director, Group Transformation in January 2019 and joined the Main Board as Finance and Transformation Director in August 2019.
He succeeded Jack Bowles, who stepped down from the Board on 15 May 2023.

citations.title: Tadeu Marroco - Tobacco Reporter

sentences.text: Tadeu Marroco, a BAT veteran since 1992 and previously group finance director, became chief executive in May 2023, with the board citing his record of building teams to deliver the transformation and his focus on execution and financial performance.

sentences.quote: BAT said its smokeless portfolio - including Vuse, glo and Velo - reached more than 31 million adult consumers globally by the end of 2025, contributing 18.2% of its GBP 25.6 billion annual revenue.
sentences.text: Full-year 2025 was delivered at the top end of guidance, and smokeless brands reached more than 31 million consumers, or 18.2% of GBP 25.6bn revenue.

On capital allocation, management funded buybacks from partial ITC disposals, starting with a GBP 1.6bn programme announced in March 2024, expanded to GBP 1.1bn for 2025 and extended with GBP 1.3bn for 2026, while targeting leverage of 2-2.5x by end-2026.

thesis_pillars.text: British American Tobacco's smokeless transformation is scaling, with New Categories revenue up 18.0% in H1 2026 and smokeless products at 19.8% of group revenue. Modern Oral is now its largest New Category, with 39.2% volume share in top markets and revenue up 65.9%. Combustibles still fund the transition, with revenue up 2.1% on price/mix of 6.8%. The United States is a growth cornerstone, with total revenue up 8.5% and New Category revenue up nearly 60%. Cash generation supports returns, with free cash flow before dividends up 85% to 2.3 billion pounds alongside a 1.3 billion pound buyback and progressive dividend, and management targets 50% of revenue from non-combustibles by 2035.
